sql_templates.description: Get latest date FII/DII flows, market regimes, breadth, and Nifty 50 index data.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
SELECT
    f.trade_date,
    f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.flow_signal, f.fii_trend, f.dii_trend,
    r.regime, r.confidence, r.days_in_regime,
    b.advances, b.declines, b.ad_signal, b.market_sentiment,
    i.close AS nifty500_close, i.trend_signal, i.trading_signal
FROM
    signals.fii_dii_flows f
JOIN
    signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN
    breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN
    market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date AND i.index_symbol = 'NIFTY_50'
WHERE
    f.trade_date = (SELECT trade_date FROM latest_date);
